description: Behavioral evals for MR-brain diffusion-UNet finetuning through NV-Generate-CTMR.

evals.prompt: Fine-tune the NV-Generate MR brain diffusion model using images listed in /data/mrbrain/datalist.json.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses scripts/run_mr_brain_finetune.py with --data-base-dir, --output-dir, and the datalist path.
assertions: the agent states the output checkpoint is experimental and not clinically validated

evals.prompt: Check whether my MR-brain finetune datalist is runnable before launching the GPU job.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs the wrapper with --preflight and does not start training.
assertions: the command does not call scripts.diff_model_train.py directly
the agent explains that real training still requires NIfTI images and model weights

baseline_methodology.with_skill_setup: Agent has the wrapper contract and wrapper contract and existing upstream script sequence.
baseline_methodology.without_skill_setup: Agent sees only the notebook and may paste notebook cells or call internal training functions out of order.
baseline_methodology.expected_delta: with_skill: validates datalist and orchestrates the existing upstream embedding, training, and optional inference scripts. without_skill: higher risk of missing embedding sidecar generation or path staging.
